items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: I'll take the two men down to the recording studio, which Big Bill is playing guitar and singing some blues. ... Is that the Big Bill and that Brunsey that we all know? ... Great, big, brown-skinned guy from, I think he was from New Orleans

ctx.x: Elliot Washington. Elliot Washington. And so I says, yeah, I says, now I'll give you a number, you go down and see about him and get him and tell him I'm here and that we want him to go out and I say to so-and-so, and he'll listen to you and he'll come with you. Now, I'll take the two men down to the recording studio, which Big Bill is playing guitar and singing some blues.
Is that the Big Bill and that Brunsey that we all know?
Great, big, brown-skinned guy from, I think he was from New Orleans
